Dear Tessitura Bellomo S.p.A.,

We are writing to inform you that we have paid your invoices TB-10609 and TB-18043 in full.

Invoice TB-10609, dated 2026-12-01, for 2099.20 EUR has been paid.
Invoice TB-18043, dated 2026-12-09, for 2965.50 EUR has been paid.

Please direct any questions to our accounts payable department.

Best regards,
Acme Components Accounts Payable
